tool.description: Summarize text by extracting its most important sentences using the TextRank algorithm (a graph-based PageRank over sentence similarity — no AI model, fully local and deterministic). Returns the top `sentences` sentences (default 3) in their original order, verbatim from the source. Best for articles, reports, or transcripts.

text.description: The text to summarize (a few sentences or more).

sentences.description: How many sentences the summary should contain (default 3).
